title: There Were Five Chairs At Dinner #shorts #horror
description: A CreepyCartoonTales story. What would you do? Tell us in the comments.
lines: Imagine you set the table for dinner. Four plates. Four chairs.
Mum, Dad, your sister, and you.
You sit down. Everyone is smiling.
Then you count the chairs. Five.
Nobody else notices. They pass the rice right over it.
The fifth plate is already full. Steam is rising.
The spoon on it lifts. By itself.
Your sister laughs and says, "Stop staring at Grandpa."
You never met your grandpa. He died before you were born.
Would you say hello, or run? Comment A or B.
